subtitle: 첨상 렌드 방의 전탱 비스 대참사

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
첨상 렌드에서 드디어
필살의 비수 떴다!
내 에픽 단검이다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle shot in a 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, 노움 도적 leaps in pure ecstasy with sparkling eyes and both fists raised, her daggers neatly sheathed at her waist so her hands are free. Beside her sits an open dark-iron dungeon boss chest emitting a bright epic purple glow on a minimal dark stone floor patch.

equip_effects: 발동 효과: 다음 3초 동안의 모든 공격은 치명타 및 극대화로 적중됩니다.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
공속 1.70에 3초 올치명?
영격 돌리기 딱 좋네.
도적도 도검 먹으니 입찰!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder side view in sleek 3-to-3.5 head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, tank 오크 전사 with her sturdy metal tank shield strapped on her back and her sword sheathed at her hip grins shamelessly while tossing a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters. On the right, 노움 도적 freezes mid-celebration, turning her head in disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐만요 전사님!
도적이 뻔히 옆에 있는데
진짜로 주사위 굴렸어요?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up dramatic confrontation angle in sleek 3-to-3.5 head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, 노움 도적 leans forward frantically with wide panicked eyes, waving both empty hands with her daggers stowed at her belt. On the right, tank 오크 전사 holds a sturdy kite shield on her left arm with her sword sheathed, crossing her free hand casually without a shred of guilt.

Wide silent deadpan freeze-frame shot in sleek 3-to-3.5 head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, tank 오크 전사 proudly admires a single compact purple-glowing epic dagger in her right hand alongside her heavy metal tank shield on her left arm, with her previous sword stowed away cleanly. On the right, 노움 도적 collapses face-down on a minimal stone floor patch in silent shock with comical fountain tears.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
도적님 울지 마…
다음부턴 전탱 거르고
보기랑 야드랑 가자.
cuts.visual_prompt: Slightly high-angle aftermath shot in sleek 3-to-3.5 head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the right, 드워프 사냥꾼 with her wooden blunderbuss slung cleanly on her back and her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief sitting calmly beside her gently pats the slumped shoulder of 노움 도적 on the left. 노움 도적 sits cross-legged on a minimal ground shadow, sniffling into empty hands while staring vacantly at the floor.
